title: Batch account notifications
description: A notification refactor introduces per-account subjects and changes how sends are scheduled.
commitMessage: Generate personalized subjects while batching monthly email sends.
reviewContext: Only accounts with allowEmail=true may receive email. A successful notifyAccounts call may resolve only after every eligible send finishes. It must reject if any send fails; waiting for or cancelling sibling sends after a failure is not required. Parallel sending is allowed. Accounts and addresses have already been validated. No notification retries are performed inside this function.
